notes.title: #2 Construction Preview
notes.notes:
Hello and welcome to this preview of the construction system found in Metroland.
Follow Metroland discussion on Discord! https://discord.gg/sHSDN5Fpw4

An important part of the game is the construction of houses alongside transport routes. The player must transport construction materials and equipment to the site of construction.
